title: audit-log-exporter: wire retention & S3 sink for Private installer (helm + terraform + upgrade tests)
author: Priya Rao
description: Motivation: Private deployments must export audit logs to customer-configured retention sinks (S3 and long-term retention backends) to satisfy enterprise compliance. This PR wires the audit-log-exporter into the Private installer (helm charts + terraform module), exposes retention configuration, adds S3 sink wiring, and includes upgrade/rollback test coverage to validate operator flows. Summary of changes: 1) Helm: add audit-log-exporter subchart and values mapping for private deployments; add retention policy fields (retention.days, retention.policy) and S3 sink configuration (s3.bucket, s3.region, s3.roleArn). 2) Terraform: expose audit exporter sink resources in the private infra module; add optional aws_s3_bucket and iam_role resources and example variables for customers deploying with managed infra. 3) Installer: the private installer (kustomize + render pipeline) now generates the correct secrets/ConfigMaps for audit-log-exporter and wires them into the private control plane chart. 4) Upgrade/rollback tooling: add post-upgrade verification scripts to smoke-check that exporter is running and that retention settings are enforced; add rollback hooks to revert S3 sink creation when a deployment fails. 5) Tests: integration tests added to perf-canary and private-installer CI that run against a local kind cluster and a mocked S3 endpoint (minio) to validate end-to-end export and retention enforcement. 6) Docs & examples: update quickstart and example-values files with audit exporter configuration and troubleshooting tips. Checklist: - [x] Helm chart changes reviewed and linted - [x] Terraform changes applied in a staging run - [x] Integration tests passing against minio in CI - [x] Security review for IAM assumptions - [x] Release notes drafted Context: This work closes ENG-1423 (audit export for Private) and is required for customers subject to longer retention requirements and S3-based archival policies. The change aims to be backward-compatible: default behavior keeps audit exporter disabled unless values are provided. Important notes: we intentionally separate sink creation from enabling the exporter so customers who manage resources externally can supply existing bucket/role ARNs. There is a short migration path for clusters that had the exporter enabled via older charts (see rollout_notes).

review_conversation: Ben: Please split IAM role creation behind a flag and document least-privilege rationale. Priya: done — flag 'create_s3_resources' added and documented; role policy narrowed to only PutObject and ListBucket on the target prefix. Diego: Add a post-upgrade smokecheck to avoid silent failures after chart upgrades. Priya: added installer hook script and test. Sofia: Security review — we need to ensure secrets are stored via KMS in private installations. Priya: added support for KMS-encrypted secrets and updated values/example. Ben: Approving after CI green. Diego: Approved. Merge performed by squash after rebase and CI rerun.
ci_details: CI summary: initial run failed due to flaky minio startup (integration job). Re-run triggered by author after adding a readiness probe timeout in the test harness, subsequent run passed. Checks: unit-tests (pass), helm-lint (pass), terraform-validate (pass), integration-private-audit (pass), security-scan (pass), e2e-smoke (pass).
testing_notes: Local testing: use 'make dev-kind' followed by 'ci/integration/private-audit-exporter-test.sh --minio' to validate. Staging: terraform plan applied with create_s3_resources=false to test chart-only changes. CI: mocked S3 (minio) used for deterministic tests. Upgrade test: 1) install previous chart without exporter, 2) upgrade with exporter enabled+create_s3_resources=true, 3) validate audit events land in minio and retention metadata is applied. Rollback test: intentionally fail post-upgrade smokecheck and assert rollback hooks remove created S3 resources when flagged.
rollout_notes: Rollout plan: 1) Ship as non-default (exporter disabled by default). 2) Customers opt-in by setting values.auditExporter.enabled=true and either provide existing s3 bucket/role or set create_s3_resources=true. 3) For upgrades from pre-exporter clusters, run 'installer/upgrade-hooks/exporter-smokecheck.sh' in staging to verify. 4) If using managed infra, recommend create_s3_resources=false and supply ARNs. 5) Telemetry: console will surface exporter health and last-export timestamp. Backout: disable values.auditExporter.enabled and run installer rollback hook; if create_s3_resources=true then run scripts/rollback/rollback-audit-sink.sh to remove bucket and role if desired.
release_notes: Private installer: audit-log-exporter integration added (opt-in). New Helm values: auditExporter.enabled, auditExporter.retention.days, auditExporter.s3.bucket, auditExporter.s3.region, auditExporter.s3.roleArn, auditExporter.createS3Resources. Terraform: optional S3 and IAM resources exposed in private module. Upgrade: includes smokecheck and rollback hooks. See docs/private/audit-logging.md for configuration and migration guidance.
